newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Mesa Inc Q2 loss including items.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Mesa Inc Q2 loss including items.

text.p: (All data above in millions except per share numbers)
NOTE: Full co name Mesa Inc

Q2 Operating income fell 37 percent to $13.3 million compared with $21.1 million. Operating results were helped by the increase in oil and condensate production as a result of acquisitions to date in 1997.
Q2 1997 includes a one-time $5 million loss from selling its remaining natural gas vehicle businesses.
Q2 1996 includes a gain of $15.0 million from revaluating reserves and contingencies and a $3.6 million charge from cutting staff.
Net income is before dividends on preferred stock.
Q2 1997 net losses exclude dividends on preferred stock of $5.6 million in the quarter. Six months 1997 excludes $11.1 million of dividends.
